_doc: The world-depth seat moves (user rulings 2026-11-25/26; Travel & Map rule 6 'Sect halls', Provinces rule 2a, World Generation rules 16 and 16a). Read by tools/design/map/export_continent.py after every place is appended: the new seat place (to) becomes the sect's great or minor seat under the seat's names, the old seat (from) a sect_hall under old_becomes; array is the founder's array (World Generation Formula G); routes are the page's new routes (track, or road where the page says road), measured on the land. year dates the move for chronicle names. Drafted from the sect pages (each field's source quoted in sources), names for the Shore House, Gate Hermitage, Spring House, Plum Gate, Rain Tower, Hundred-Bell Eaves and Spring Return approved by the user 2026-11-26. events_at_old: chronicle events dated after the move that the page places at the old seat (now the sect hall).
